propositions: Rebar must safely support multiple LLM providers (Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic), VCS platforms (Gerrit, GitHub, GitLab), CI/CD systems (Jenkins), issue trackers (Jira Cloud/DC), and deployment environments (local, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, AWS) without weakening SDK-native refresh, workload identity, credential-helper protection, or rotation mechanisms.

A universal secret broker or hand-rolled credential store in Rebar introduces unacceptable risk; instead, upstream SDKs, helpers, and CI/deployment platforms must own credential issuance, retrieval, persistence, refresh, rotation, and precedence while Rebar ensures safe passage through typed provider bindings and operation-scoped construction.

Static credentials must not appear in operation snapshots, caches, fingerprints, tickets, MCP arguments, CLI arguments, logs, or errors; they are materialized only inside provider-specific non-serializable containers at adapter boundaries and unwrapped only at the sending adapter.

Deployment resolves external secret stores (SSM, vaults, etc.) before process startup and supplies exactly one key file (preferred) or multiline environment variable; Rebar service startup validates, copies to a process-owned 0700-directory/0600-file runtime before accepting work, and binds context-locally without global os.environ mutation; static credential rotation occurs by restart or redeploy.

Trusted same-capability child processes inherit the ambient environment for Git/SSH/AWS credential-process/proxy/CA/runtime compatibility; Rebar removes only exact secret variable names declared by other adapters from unrelated sibling children and overlays Rebar-materialized static values only onto their owning child without mutating global os.environ.

Provider-native credential, identity, and session capabilities (boto3 Session, Anthropic AccessTokenProvider, OpenAI workload identity) are injected into Rebar-owned factories; Rebar constructs, owns, and closes the official SDK client; arbitrary whole-client injection is not permitted because it could bypass Rebar retry, timeout, cache, output, error, or lifecycle policy.
